prompts.label: Template prompt
prompts.text: Bring the photo to life and keep the person exactly as photographed: same face, hair, skin tone, age and clothes, in the same room. Filmed on a phone propped up in front of them, like a front-camera video. They chat and smile at the camera, completely unaware. Behind them, a tall, gaunt ghost woman with pale grey-green skin, long straight grey hair, round staring white eyes, a wide unnatural grin and long bony clawed fingers, slowly rises into view over their shoulder, hunched, both clawed hands lifting up on either side of them, and leans in closer and closer, grinning at the camera. The person glances back once, sees nothing, turns back to the camera and keeps talking while the ghost hovers right behind their head. Creepy, not gory: no blood, no wounds, the ghost never grabs or hurts anyone. One continuous shot, natural indoor light, vertical 9:16 video. Quiet room tone with a low eerie drone in the audio, no music with vocals. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.
